name: VRS-1 Variance-Ratio Regime Switch
description: Lo-MacKinlay variance ratio VR = Var(q-bar move) / (q * Var(1-bar move)) classifies the regime each bar. VR >= 1.15 (trending) takes 20-bar Donchian breakouts; VR <= 0.85 (mean-reverting) fades Bollinger band crossbacks; between the two it stands aside. Stop and target are both fixed at entry from ATR(14) -- trend 1.2/2.4x, reversion 1.0/1.2x -- plus a 48-bar max-hold flatten. No trailing stop.
pineSource:
//@version=6
// VRS-1 "Variance-Ratio Regime Switch" — crypto port (24/7, no session filter)
// KEPT: Lo-MacKinlay variance-ratio regime classification; Donchian breakout in TREND;
//       Bollinger band-fade in REVERT; fixed ATR stop + target set at entry; max-hold flatten.
// REFUSED/DROPPED: nothing forbidden was requested. No trailing stop (fixed SL/TP by design),
//       no pyramiding, no cross-symbol data, no martingale or averaging down.
strategy("VRS-1 Variance-Ratio Regime Switch", overlay=true,
     pyramiding=1, process_orders_on_close=true,
     commission_type=strategy.commission.percent, commission_value=0.05,
     initial_capital=10000,
     default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=100,
     margin_long=100, margin_short=100)

// ---- inputs ----
q       = input.int(5,     "VR horizon q")
L       = input.int(120,   "VR lookback")
vrHi    = input.float(1.15, "Trend threshold")
vrLo    = input.float(0.85, "Revert threshold")
dcLen   = input.int(20,    "Donchian length")
bbLen   = input.int(20,    "BB length")
bbMult  = input.float(2.0, "BB mult")
atrLen  = input.int(14,    "ATR length")
tSL     = input.float(1.2, "Trend SL xATR")
tTP     = input.float(2.4, "Trend TP xATR")
rSL     = input.float(1.0, "Revert SL xATR")
rTP     = input.float(1.2, "Revert TP xATR")
maxBars = input.int(48,    "Max bars in trade")

// ---- variance ratio: VR = Var(q-bar move) / (q * Var(1-bar move)) ----
r1 = close - close[1]
rq = close - close[q]
v1 = ta.variance(r1, L)
vq = ta.variance(rq, L)
vr = v1 > 0 ? vq / (q * v1) : na

// ---- signal series ----
atr = ta.atr(atrLen)
[bbMid, bbUp, bbLo] = ta.bb(close, bbLen, bbMult)
hh = ta.highest(high, dcLen)[1]
ll = ta.lowest(low, dcLen)[1]

trendRegime  = not na(vr) and vr >= vrHi
revertRegime = not na(vr) and vr <= vrLo

longTrend  = trendRegime  and ta.crossover(close, hh)
shortTrend = trendRegime  and ta.crossunder(close, ll)
longRev    = revertRegime and ta.crossover(close, bbLo)
shortRev   = revertRegime and ta.crossunder(close, bbUp)

// ---- state ----
var float slPx   = na
var float tpPx   = na
var int   barsIn = 0

flat = strategy.position_size == 0

// ---- entries: stop and target are both computed at the moment of entry ----
if flat and longTrend
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
    slPx   := close - atr * tSL
    tpPx   := close + atr * tTP
    barsIn := 0
else if flat and shortTrend
    strategy.entry("S", strategy.short)
    slPx   := close + atr * tSL
    tpPx   := close - atr * tTP
    barsIn := 0
else if flat and longRev
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
    slPx   := close - atr * rSL
    tpPx   := close + atr * rTP
    barsIn := 0
else if flat and shortRev
    strategy.entry("S", strategy.short)
    slPx   := close + atr * rSL
    tpPx   := close - atr * rTP
    barsIn := 0

// ---- exits: fixed bracket re-issued each bar at the SAME prices set on entry ----
if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("LX", from_entry="L", stop=slPx, limit=tpPx)
    barsIn := barsIn + 1
if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("SX", from_entry="S", stop=slPx, limit=tpPx)
    barsIn := barsIn + 1

// ---- max-hold flatten (time stop, not a trailing stop) ----
if barsIn >= maxBars and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all()
    barsIn := 0

plot(vr, title="VarianceRatio")
plot(trendRegime ? 1 : revertRegime ? -1 : 0, title="Regime")
notes: REJECTED. The regime switch has no edge at this trade frequency: average trade is roughly -0.02%, and commission at 0.05% consumes 36-53% of gross profit across both symbols. Note the engine's forced parity profile sizes every trade at 100% of equity, which is NOT the spec's 0.5%-risk sizing -- so this tests the signal, not the spec's risk management. The signal is what failed. The ETH run also raised an 'oversized_position_sizing' warning from the engine. Commission paid $7,937 against $14,895 gross profit.

name: LCR-1 Liquidation Cascade Reclaim
description: Detects a liquidation cascade bar (range > 2.5x ATR50 AND volume > 3x its 50-bar average AND a new 50-bar extreme), then lets the close position inside that bar pick the side. A down-cascade closing in the upper half means the forced sellers are cleared, so fade it long; one closing on its low means the chain is still running, so follow it short. Mirrored for up-cascades. Stop beyond the cascade wick, target at 2R, both fixed at entry, risk floored at 1.2% of price so commission stays a small fraction of R.
pineSource:
//@version=6
// LCR-1 "Liquidation Cascade Reclaim" — BTCUSDT, 15m and 5m.
// Detect a cascade bar (range expansion + volume spike + new 50-bar extreme), then let the CLOSE
// POSITION inside that bar decide the side: a rejected flush is faded, a flush that closes on its
// low is followed. Stop and target both fixed at entry; risk floored at 1.2% so the round-trip fee
// stays a small fraction of R (HARD LESSON 3).
// No trailing stop, no pyramiding, no averaging down, no martingale.
strategy("LCR-1 Liquidation Cascade Reclaim", overlay=true,
     pyramiding=1, process_orders_on_close=true,
     commission_type=strategy.commission.percent, commission_value=0.05,
     initial_capital=10000,
     default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=100,
     margin_long=100, margin_short=100)

lenN     = input.int(50,    "Lookback for ATR / volume / extremes")
rangeK   = input.float(2.5, "Cascade: range > K x ATR")
volK     = input.float(3.0, "Cascade: volume > K x average")
revLo    = input.float(0.55,"Down cascade: closePos at/above this = reversion long")
contLo   = input.float(0.25,"Down cascade: closePos at/below this = continuation short")
revHi    = input.float(0.45,"Up cascade: closePos at/below this = reversion short")
contHi   = input.float(0.75,"Up cascade: closePos at/above this = continuation long")
bufK     = input.float(0.2, "Stop buffer beyond the cascade extreme, x ATR")
rr       = input.float(2.0, "Reward:risk")
minRpct  = input.float(1.20,"Min risk as % of price")
maxRpct  = input.float(4.00,"Max risk as % of price")
maxBars  = input.int(96,    "Max bars in trade")

atrN   = ta.atr(lenN)
volAvg = ta.sma(volume, lenN)
rng    = high - low

// ---- cascade detection ----
bigRange = not na(atrN) and atrN > 0 and rng > rangeK * atrN
bigVol   = not na(volAvg) and volAvg > 0 and volume > volK * volAvg
cascade  = bigRange and bigVol

newLow  = low  <= ta.lowest(low,  lenN)[1]
newHigh = high >= ta.highest(high, lenN)[1]

downCascade = cascade and newLow
upCascade   = cascade and newHigh

closePos = rng > 0 ? (close - low) / rng : 0.5

// ---- the regime switch: where the close sits decides the side ----
revLong   = downCascade and closePos >= revLo
contShort = downCascade and closePos <= contLo
revShort  = upCascade   and closePos <= revHi
contLong  = upCascade   and closePos >= contHi

// ---- risk, floored so commission stays a small fraction of R ----
buf  = na(atrN) ? 0.0 : atrN * bufK
minR = close * minRpct / 100
maxR = close * maxRpct / 100

rawLongR  = close - (low - buf)
rawShortR = (high + buf) - close
longR     = math.min(math.max(rawLongR,  minR), maxR)
shortR    = math.min(math.max(rawShortR, minR), maxR)

goLong  = revLong  or contLong
goShort = revShort or contShort

var float slPx   = na
var float tpPx   = na
var int   barsIn = 0

flat = strategy.position_size == 0

if flat and goLong and longR > 0
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
    slPx   := close - longR
    tpPx   := close + longR * rr
    barsIn := 0
else if flat and goShort and shortR > 0
    strategy.entry("S", strategy.short)
    slPx   := close + shortR
    tpPx   := close - shortR * rr
    barsIn := 0

if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("LX", from_entry="L", stop=slPx, limit=tpPx)
    barsIn := barsIn + 1
if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("SX", from_entry="S", stop=slPx, limit=tpPx)
    barsIn := barsIn + 1

if barsIn >= maxBars and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all()
    barsIn := 0

plot(cascade ? 1 : 0,   title="CascadeBar")
plot(closePos,          title="ClosePos")
plot(revLong or revShort ? 1 : contLong or contShort ? -1 : 0, title="ReversionVsContinuation")
notes: Ladder stopped at rung A: PF 0.69 < 0.95, so no 5m run and no sensitivity sweep. 1 credit spent. THE PRE-REGISTERED ESTIMATE WAS WRONG BY 4-10x: I predicted 150-400 trades, the strategy took 1,532. 'Cascade' bars at 2.5x ATR + 3x volume + new 50-bar extreme fire on roughly 1% of bars, not the 0.1-0.3% I assumed. The risk floor DID work as designed -- avgWin/avgLoss came in at 1.68 -- but at that payoff ratio the strategy needs a ~37% win rate to break even and only achieved 29.2%. So the closePos regime switch did not select the right side. Commission was $3,604 on $21,442 gross (17%), meaningful but not the primary cause this time; the primary cause is that the signal is wrong.

name: MAR-1 Moving-Average Retest Fade
description: Mechanized from a charted XBTUSD setup. A sloped EMA200 is the regime switch and the level: when it slopes down it acts as resistance, so price rallying up to tag it and closing back below is a short; mirrored when it slopes up. Stop just beyond the MA, target the opposite Bollinger band measured at entry and never moved, clamped between 1R and 4R. Risk floored at 0.8% of price.
pineSource:
//@version=6
// MAR-1 "Moving-Average Retest Fade" — BTCUSDT.
// From a charted setup: a slow MA sloping down acts as resistance. Price rallies up, TAGS the MA,
// and rejects back below it -> short. Target is the opposite band of a volatility channel.
// Mirrored for an up-sloping MA. The MA slope IS the regime switch.
// Stop and target both fixed at entry. No trailing stop, no pyramiding, no averaging down.
strategy("MAR-1 Moving-Average Retest Fade", overlay=true,
     pyramiding=1, process_orders_on_close=true,
     commission_type=strategy.commission.percent, commission_value=0.05,
     initial_capital=10000,
     default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=100,
     margin_long=100, margin_short=100)

slowLen  = input.int(200,   "Slow MA length (the blue line)")
slopeLen = input.int(20,    "Bars used to measure MA slope")
slopeMin = input.float(0.10,"Min MA slope over that span, % of price")
bbLen    = input.int(20,    "Band length")
bbMult   = input.float(2.0, "Band multiplier")
bufK     = input.float(0.25,"Stop buffer beyond the MA, x ATR")
atrLen   = input.int(14,    "ATR length")
minRpct  = input.float(0.80,"Min risk as % of price")
maxRpct  = input.float(3.00,"Max risk as % of price")
minRR    = input.float(1.0, "Target floor, in R")
maxRR    = input.float(4.0, "Target cap, in R")
maxBars  = input.int(96,    "Max bars in trade")

slowMA = ta.ema(close, slowLen)
atr    = ta.atr(atrLen)
[bbMid, bbUp, bbLo] = ta.bb(close, bbLen, bbMult)

// ---- regime: the slope of the slow MA ----
slopeAbs = slowMA - slowMA[slopeLen]
slopePct = close > 0 ? slopeAbs / close * 100 : 0.0
downTrend = not na(slowMA[slopeLen]) and slopePct <= -slopeMin
upTrend   = not na(slowMA[slopeLen]) and slopePct >=  slopeMin

// ---- the retest: price reaches the MA this bar, then closes back on the trend side ----
tagFromBelow = high >= slowMA and close < slowMA and close < open
tagFromAbove = low  <= slowMA and close > slowMA and close > open

goShort = downTrend and tagFromBelow
goLong  = upTrend   and tagFromAbove

// ---- risk: stop beyond the MA that just rejected price ----
buf  = na(atr) ? 0.0 : atr * bufK
minR = close * minRpct / 100
maxR = close * maxRpct / 100

rawShortR = (slowMA + buf) - close
rawLongR  = close - (slowMA - buf)
shortR    = math.min(math.max(rawShortR, minR), maxR)
longR     = math.min(math.max(rawLongR,  minR), maxR)

// ---- target: the opposite band, measured AT ENTRY and then never moved, clamped in R ----
rawShortTP = bbLo
rawLongTP  = bbUp

var float slPx   = na
var float tpPx   = na
var int   barsIn = 0

flat = strategy.position_size == 0

if flat and goShort and shortR > 0
    strategy.entry("S", strategy.short)
    slPx := close + shortR
    tgt   = math.min(math.max(rawShortTP, close - shortR * maxRR), close - shortR * minRR)
    tpPx := tgt
    barsIn := 0
else if flat and goLong and longR > 0
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
    slPx := close - longR
    tgt   = math.max(math.min(rawLongTP, close + longR * maxRR), close + longR * minRR)
    tpPx := tgt
    barsIn := 0

if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("LX", from_entry="L", stop=slPx, limit=tpPx)
    barsIn := barsIn + 1
if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("SX", from_entry="S", stop=slPx, limit=tpPx)
    barsIn := barsIn + 1

if barsIn >= maxBars and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all()
    barsIn := 0

plot(slowMA, title="SlowMA")
plot(slopePct, title="SlopePct")
plot(downTrend ? -1 : upTrend ? 1 : 0, title="Regime")
notes: Ladder stopped at rung A: PF 0.65 < 0.95. 1 credit. The payoff ratio was FINE at 2.07:1 -- the risk geometry worked. Break-even at that ratio needs a ~33% win rate; it delivered 23.8%. The tell is avgBarsWinning 27.1 vs avgBarsLosing 12.3: losers die in half the time winners take, which is the signature of a stop sitting inside the noise. Entry was AT the MA and the stop a fraction of an ATR BEYOND it -- but price oscillates around a moving average by construction, so the stop was planted in the noisiest spot on the chart. Trade-count estimate was 500-1500 and actual was 844, a much better calibration than 003. Two untested fixes are written into the spec: require a confirmed rejection rather than the first tag, and place the stop above the swing structure instead of just above the MA.

name: CRX-1 Compression Release Volume Verdict
description: A 48-bar range compresses below 3x ATR(100) and holds for five bars; price then breaks out and VOLUME delivers the verdict. Volume at or above 2x its 50-bar average means follow the break; below 1x means fade it; anything between is a dead band with no trade. Follow stops sit at the far side of the box, fade stops beyond the breakout bar's extreme, target 1.8R, all fixed at entry, risk clamped to 0.8-3.0% of price.
pineSource:
//@version=6
// CRX-1 "Compression Release, Volume Verdict" — BTCUSDT, 15m and 5m.
// A range compresses; price breaks out; VOLUME decides whether the break is real.
// Heavy volume -> follow the break. Thin volume -> fade it. In between -> no trade.
// Stops sit beyond STRUCTURE (the opposite side of the box, or beyond the breakout extreme),
// never just beyond the trigger level -- HARD LESSON 5.
// SL and TP both fixed at entry. No trailing stop, no pyramiding, no averaging down, no martingale.
strategy("CRX-1 Compression Release Volume Verdict", overlay=true,
     pyramiding=1, process_orders_on_close=true,
     commission_type=strategy.commission.percent, commission_value=0.05,
     initial_capital=10000,
     default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=100,
     margin_long=100, margin_short=100)

boxLen   = input.int(48,    "Compression box length")
atrLong  = input.int(100,   "ATR length for the compression yardstick")
tightK   = input.float(3.0, "Compressed if box width < K x ATR")
holdBars = input.int(5,     "Bars the box must stay compressed")
volLen   = input.int(50,    "Volume average length")
volHi    = input.float(2.0, "Follow the break if volume >= K x average")
volLo    = input.float(1.0, "Fade the break if volume < K x average")
bufK     = input.float(0.25,"Structural stop buffer, x ATR14")
rr       = input.float(1.8, "Reward:risk")
minRpct  = input.float(0.80,"Min risk as % of price")
maxRpct  = input.float(3.00,"Max risk as % of price")
maxBars  = input.int(96,    "Max bars in trade")

atrL   = ta.atr(atrLong)
atrS   = ta.atr(14)
volAvg = ta.sma(volume, volLen)

// ---- the box, measured BEFORE this bar so the breakout bar cannot widen it ----
boxHi = ta.highest(high, boxLen)[1]
boxLo = ta.lowest(low,  boxLen)[1]
boxW  = boxHi - boxLo

tight = not na(atrL) and atrL > 0 and boxW < atrL * tightK
// compression must have been sustained, not a one-bar accident
held  = tight[1] and tight[2] and tight[3] and tight[4] and tight[5]

// ---- the release ----
breakUp = ta.crossover(close, boxHi)
breakDn = ta.crossunder(close, boxLo)

// ---- the verdict: volume decides follow vs fade. Between the thresholds is a dead band. ----
heavy = not na(volAvg) and volAvg > 0 and volume >= volAvg * volHi
thin  = not na(volAvg) and volAvg > 0 and volume <  volAvg * volLo

followLong  = held and breakUp and heavy
followShort = held and breakDn and heavy
fadeShort   = held and breakUp and thin
fadeLong    = held and breakDn and thin

// ---- structural risk ----
buf  = na(atrS) ? 0.0 : atrS * bufK
minR = close * minRpct / 100
maxR = close * maxRpct / 100

// follow: stop at the far side of the box. fade: stop beyond the breakout bar's extreme.
rawFollowLongR  = close - (boxLo - buf)
rawFollowShortR = (boxHi + buf) - close
rawFadeShortR   = (high + buf) - close
rawFadeLongR    = close - (low - buf)

goLong  = followLong or fadeLong
goShort = followShort or fadeShort
rawLongR  = followLong  ? rawFollowLongR  : rawFadeLongR
rawShortR = followShort ? rawFollowShortR : rawFadeShortR
longR     = math.min(math.max(rawLongR,  minR), maxR)
shortR    = math.min(math.max(rawShortR, minR), maxR)

var float slPx   = na
var float tpPx   = na
var int   barsIn = 0

flat = strategy.position_size == 0

if flat and goLong and longR > 0
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
    slPx   := close - longR
    tpPx   := close + longR * rr
    barsIn := 0
else if flat and goShort and shortR > 0
    strategy.entry("S", strategy.short)
    slPx   := close + shortR
    tpPx   := close - shortR * rr
    barsIn := 0

if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("LX", from_entry="L", stop=slPx, limit=tpPx)
    barsIn := barsIn + 1
if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("SX", from_entry="S", stop=slPx, limit=tpPx)
    barsIn := barsIn + 1
